item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council to vote Monday on Tradition commercial rezoning near Crosstown Parkway
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council is scheduled to hold a second reading and final vote Monday on a proposed land use change in Tradition that would convert nearly 9.5 acres near Crosstown Parkway and SW Fairgreen Drive from residential to commercial designation. item.title: TCCEED doubles employer participation in second year of paid summer internship program
item.description: The Treasure Coast workforce development program placed 61 students in local jobs this summer while tripling the number of applications from area students.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon women's title after recovering from five blown match points
item.description: The 21-year-old Czech player defeated Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Three-Game Skid With 4-1 Win Over Jupiter
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets snapped a three-game losing streak Saturday evening with a wire-to-wire 4-1 win over the Jupiter Hammerheads at Roger Dean Chevrolet Stadium.

item.title: Lightning strike ignites one of two Martin County brush fires this week
item.description: Martin County experienced two brush fires this week, with lightning causing at least one of the blazes.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
